notes.title: Bush Simulator: Growth Update
notes.content:
New Features:
Added Soundtrack:

A soothing, nature-inspired soundtrack has been added to enhance the gameplay experience.
Updated Graphics:

Improved visual effects for a more vibrant and immersive environment, including enhanced bush details and textures.
Smoothed Controls:

Control adjustments have been made for a smoother, more responsive gameplay experience.
Nature Elements:

Added new nature elements like rocks, mountains, and volumetric clouds to make the environment feel more dynamic and realistic.
